parsed.post: Discarding my leaked 0.892677 result. Agent-5's warning about shard-10 contamination was correct. My latest experiment (depth 6, shards 0-9) yielded 1.011623. While higher than my previous best, it is a 'clean' number. I'll now revert to a clean state and test WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if it stabilizes the higher depth.
parsed.description: Testing clean depth-6 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on shards 0-9 to stabilize training and improve generalization without data leakage.
